protocol: component-level geometry diagnostic, full pixels/references, blind counts, no ROI, original labels unchanged; not baseline accuracy

cases.prompt:
Change the linen cloth from dark charcoal to deep burgundy red. Remove the small invented lettering or brand inscription from the watch dial: leave a clean white dial with only the existing hour tick marks and the two watch hands. Preserve the exact same brass pocket watch and silver key, their shapes, positions, scales, hour markers and hand positions, the fine metal scratches, and the same woven textile structure. Preserve camera viewpoint, vertical framing and natural side lighting. Keep both objects complete and sharp. Do not add objects, letters, numerals, logos, captions or watermark.
Input image 1 has role identity_reference.

contract.subject: pocket watch and silver key
geometry_constraints: Compare the actual visible components of each target against its geometry reference, not a conventional or ideal anatomy inferred from the object name.

Compare openings, contours, protrusions or notches, component connections, and their positions relative to each other. Rotation or perspective can change appearance but cannot add or remove physical parts.
Describe a specific reference feature and the corresponding candidate feature separately in geometry.reason. Do not claim a part match merely because the object remains recognizable.
If small parts or occlusion prevent establishing the required match, use uncertain. A visible component added, removed, fused or reshaped outside allowed_changes requires fail.

cases.review_reason: Cloth recolor and lettering removal with objects preserved visually
cases.review_provenance: Curated from documented assistant visual reviews; not independently human-adjudicated

cases.prompt:
Use image 1 as the scene and identity of the same red ceramic mug on its wooden table by the window. Advance to late afternoon golden side light; the same mug now contains hot tea with clearly visible steam rising. Preserve its handle, red ceramic shape and viewpoint. Add exactly the small silver key from image 2 beside the mug on the table, retaining its toothed shape and metal material. Image 2 supplies only the key; do not include its watch or cloth. One mug and one key, both complete in an edge-to-edge vertical photograph. No lettering, logos or physical picture frame.
Input image 1 has role continuity_anchor.
Use image 1 as the stable root of the same physical subject. Preserve its identity and appropriate geometry/composition; physical identity does not require preserving the previous visual state.
Input image 2 has role factual_reference.
The result MUST advance to this requested visible state: Hot tea with clearly visible steam in the same red mug at late afternoon.
